items.title: Karolina Strassmayer interviewed by Monk Rowe, May 25, 2023
items.q: a New Orleans musician who called themself the last free jazz player — Kidd Jordan

ctx.x: What about song titles? I was looking at a couple — now it seemed to me that a couple of the song titles on your videos could be descriptive. There was “Mallets and Air” and you had a mallet player and you were playing the flute. Okay. Now I’m not sure if that was totally on purpose but I remember talking to one person, a New Orleans musician who called themself the last free jazz player — Kidd Jordan. And they were talking about song titles after they had done quote a free album. And one they named “Last of the…

Either by being descriptive like “Mallets and Air” definitely, sure, that’s — or another one on this recent CD is like “Drum Roll, Please.” And it started with a drum roll. But sometimes I call things, I call tunes for things that just go on in my life. You know for instance a few years ago I did this record “Of Mystery and Beauty” and that’s really when I began to think about what we were talking about before, this desire to create beauty. And that I see our jobs as musicians really to be in this mystery and…
